messages:
maria: quick design review for embeddings & reranking UI — dropped a figma link: https://figma.redwood/emb-rerank. main things to resolve: batch input flow, vector preview, relevance table layout, and export copy/options. looking for quick takes.

oliver: looking now. big question — are we doing vector preview inline or a modal? inline table could get wide. :thinking:

devon: modal makes sense for full vector view. inline we can show a compact preview (dim count + norm) and a chevron to open modal for full vector. lazy-load modal to avoid perf hit.

sunita: agree. for modal add two tabs: raw vector (copyable) and derived metrics (norm, top-ks). also want ability to show a small 2D projection (pca/umap) for quick cluster view.

kevin: accessibility nits: ensure modal gets focus trap, close on ESC, aria-label="Vector preview" and announce when content loads. color for relevance bars must meet 4.5:1 contrast.

maria: copy nit — we currently use "Similarity" and "Score" interchangeably. prefer unified label: "Relevance score (cosine)" with hover tooltip: "Higher = more relevant; computed from embedding cosine similarity."

oliver: +1 to explicit metric wording. For the relevance table, propose columns: Rank, Document, Snippet, Relevance score, Vector dim (optional). Sortable and filterable by score range.

devon: UI idea: allow pinning columns and a compact density toggle. For batch runs show a progress bar per-batch and per-row error icons with hover for error details.

sunita: for batch inputs support: paste multi-line, CSV upload, and drag/drop. validate rows server-side and show sample errors inline with line numbers. Also allow re-run only failed rows.

kevin: keyboard support: ensure row expansion (for snippet + actions) is reachable via Enter/Space when focused. tooltips must be accessible (focusable). Export button must have aria-haspopup if it opens a menu.

maria: export options — users asked to export vectors sometimes. propose: Export -> CSV (results only), Export -> CSV + vectors (warning about size), Export -> NDJSON (for downstream processing). copy for the export confirmation: "Include vectors? Vectors can be large — export may take longer and generate a big file."

oliver: please include an estimated size calc in the modal (e.g., ~12MB if include vectors). if vectors checked, show checkbox default off.

devon: implementation detail: compress vectors (gzip) server-side and send .csv.gz or .ndjson.gz. UI shows compressed size estimate. Also add rate-limited background job with email/download link.

sunita: also add schema export (json schema or column list) so users know column order and dimensions. put a small "schema" link next to export.

kevin: microcopy for empty state: instead of "No results" use "No results match your query." include a suggestion line: "Try a broader query or increase the search radius." ensure screen reader sees the suggestion.

maria: reranking UX: inline rerank (instant) vs background rerank. for big batches, offer "Run in background" with toast + notification. default to async for >250 rows. show estimated time.

oliver: what about the rerank button label? "Rerank results" vs "Recompute relevance". prefer shorter: "Rerank" with tooltip "Recompute relevance scores using current model settings."

devon: add an action menu on each row: Copy vector, Preview vector, Exclude from rerank. keep primary actions compact.

sunita: when previewing vectors include a small legend for projection axes and a toggle to color by relevance buckets.

kevin: contrast and colorblind-safe palette for buckets, add pattern fallback for tiny bars. also ensure charts have descriptive aria-labels and data tables include hidden headers for screen readers.

maria: final checklist I propose before dev handoff: 1) modal vector preview with copy + metrics tabs, 2) compact inline vector summary, 3) batch input UX (paste/file/upload) + per-row errors, 4) export menu with size estimates and schema link, 5) table accessibility (focus, aria, contrast), 6) rerank async default for large sets, 7) copy consistency (use "Relevance score (cosine)").

oliver: looks good. can we prioritize the export size calc and async rerank? ops asked for that first.

devon: i'll put up a PR for the compact preview and the export modal this week.

sunita: I'll draft the schema doc and examples for CSV/NDJSON.

kevin: i'll run an a11y pass on the figma screens tomorrow and post notes. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — please drop :thumbsup: if you approve this checklist and i'll update the figma and tickets.

oliver: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

sunita: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:
